finalText:
All objectives verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Ticket created: **RD-1015**, title "dab3 RD Bench Ticket", customer "Bench Customer", raised 2026-08-24. It appeared at the top of the tickets list after the create refresh.

**2. DONE** — Part "dab3 RD Part A" (cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1) computed price: **$125.00** (ticket total showed $125.00).

**3. DONE** — Part "dab3 RD Part B" (cost $200.00, markup 25%, qty 1) computed price: **$250.00** (ticket total showed $375.00).

**4. DONE** — After editing Part A's cost from 100 to 150, its computed price was **$187.50** (ticket total updated to $437.50).

**5. DONE** — Status reached **Ready**. The precondition discovered: clicking "Mark Ready" while parts had no supplier produced an alert reading "Ticket is not ready" with the bullet items `Part "dab3 RD Part A" has no supplier` and `Part "dab3 RD Part B" has no supplier`. **The requirement was that every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned.** I set supplier "Bench Supplier" on both parts via Edit, after which "Mark Ready" succeeded and the status changed from Draft to Ready (buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").

**6. DONE** — Both parts were deleted (each via a "Confirm" dialog: "Delete the part \"dab3 RD Part A\" from this ticket? This cannot be undone." → "Delete part", and the same for Part B). The parts table then read "No parts on this ticket yet." The ticket was then archived — the detail page showed "Status: Ready" plus an "Archived" badge and the button changed to "Unarchive ticket". In the tickets list with "Show archived" unchecked, RD-1015 no longer appears; with "Show archived" checked it appears as "dab3 RD Bench Ticket Archived", status Ready, 0 parts. Nothing from this run remains active.
